WorkspaceSettings.title: Settings
WorkspaceSettings.subtitle: Manage this workspace's identity, access, and operating settings.

WorkspaceQualification.title: Qualification
WorkspaceQualification.description: Define what your team means by a qualified lead: the questions it answers about a contact, how much each one counts, and which ones must be met before a contact can be qualified.
WorkspaceQualification.archived: Criterion archived. Answers already recorded were kept.
WorkspaceQualification.noAccess: You do not have permission to manage qualification criteria.
WorkspaceQualification.requiredHint: A required criterion blocks the move to Qualified until it is met. It does not count for more than its weight.
WorkspaceQualification.archivedHint: Archived criteria stop scoring and stop blocking qualification. Every answer already recorded against them stays on its contact.
WorkspaceQualification.emptyFit: Whether this is the right kind of customer at all — need, authority, budget, timing.
WorkspaceQualification.emptyEngagement: Whether the relationship is actually alive — replies, meetings, momentum.
WorkspaceQualification.emptyRequired: Mark a criterion required and a contact cannot be moved to Qualified until it is met.

dimensionEmpty.FIT: No fit criteria yet. These ask whether the contact is the right kind of customer.
dimensionEmpty.ENGAGEMENT: No engagement criteria yet. These ask whether the relationship is alive.

WorkspaceDisqualification.title: Disqualification reasons
WorkspaceDisqualification.description: Define the reasons your team uses when a lead is no longer worth pursuing. Archived reasons stay readable on existing contacts and history.
WorkspaceDisqualification.archived: Disqualification reason archived. Existing contact history was kept.
WorkspaceDisqualification.loadFailedBody: The current vocabulary is unavailable. Try again before making changes.
WorkspaceDisqualification.codeInvalid: Use 2–32 characters. Start with A–Z, then use only A–Z, 0–9, or an underscore.
WorkspaceDisqualification.builtInLabelHint: Leave blank to use the built-in label in each person's language.

WorkspaceIdentity.title: Workspace identity
WorkspaceIdentity.description: Keep the name people see and the time boundary used for shared reporting accurate.

WorkspaceIdentity.slugHint: This ID appears in links and can't be changed here.

WorkspaceIdentity.noAccessBody: You need workspace settings permission to change this identity.
WorkspaceIdentity.permissionUnavailableBody: Connex could not confirm whether you may edit this workspace. Retry the check before making changes.

WorkspaceData.title: Data
WorkspaceData.subtitle: Bring existing relationship history into this workspace without triggering automation or alert noise.
WorkspaceData.historyDescription: Import historical activities, notes, and tasks from a CSV. Exact participant matches are reviewed before anything is written.

WorkspaceEmail.title: Email
WorkspaceEmail.subtitle: Send this workspace's invites from your own SMTP server. Without a custom server, mail uses the instance default.
WorkspaceEmail.enableDescription: When off, this workspace sends through the instance default sender.

WorkspaceEmail.loadFailed: Your email settings couldn't be loaded.

WorkspaceDelivery.title: Delivery
WorkspaceDelivery.subtitle: Choose how this workspace delivers campaign email. Use the workspace SMTP server, or route through a dedicated email service provider.
WorkspaceDelivery.enableDescription: When off, campaigns on this channel are held rather than delivered.
WorkspaceDelivery.smtpNote: Delivery uses this workspace's email settings. No extra configuration is needed.
WorkspaceDelivery.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the stored key. Stored encrypted; never shown.
WorkspaceDelivery.webhookDescription: Your email service provider reports deliveries, bounces, and complaints back to this URL. Generate the URL and secret below, then add both to your provider's settings.
WorkspaceDelivery.webhookSaveFirst: Save the email service provider first, then generate a webhook token.
WorkspaceDelivery.revealTitle: Store these now — you won't see them again
WorkspaceDelivery.revealWarning: This token and secret are shown only once and can't be recovered. Copy them into your email service provider now; generate a new pair if you lose them.
WorkspaceDelivery.loadFailed: Your delivery settings couldn't be loaded.
WorkspaceDelivery.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to delivery settings
WorkspaceDelivery.forbiddenBody: Ask a workspace administrator to grant you workspace settings access.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsSubtitle: Route campaign SMS through an HTTP SMS gateway. Messages are plain text and use the sender id below.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsEnableDescription: When off, SMS campaigns are held rather than delivered.
WorkspaceDelivery.smsSenderIdHint: Shown as the sender on the recipient's handset. Letters, digits, spaces, and + . _ - only.
WorkspaceDelivery.connectorsSubtitle: Push frozen campaign audiences to an external list. Configure the HTTP list connector for this workspace.
WorkspaceDelivery.connectorsEnableDescription: When off, campaign audience exports to this connector are unavailable.

WorkspaceSso.domainsHint: One domain per line. Members with these email domains are routed to this IdP.
